answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 406 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the copper. The sparrow index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the dune queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. Verification alone takes 4 days each. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
